title: Venture INC.
description: True exploration in every way, use Create Aeronautics as you venture fourth to distant structures thousands of blocks from spawn!
body:
👋 This modpack features a lot of mods that you'll enjoy, having a combination between a lot of world generation and dimension enhancements — to our main mod Create Aeronautics! It is also a part of a server made specifically for this modpack. Consider downloading this modpack and joining our server, or not, it's up to you! 

🚧- Contraption gameplay, Create Aeronautics and Create Addons-🚧
🌍- Incredible World Generation -🌍
⚔️- Terraria-like Weapons and Armor -⚔️
🛡️- Immersive Combat with Better Combat -🛡️
🌌- New End with Enderscape -🌌
🏛️- 1000+ Structures to Explore -🏛️
And more!



We also have a server dedicated to this modpack specifically that has factions, worldbuilding, and so on! A lot of time and effort has been put into this modpack and the server in-order to bring enjoyment, immersiveness, and replayability to everybody who plays. 

Discord server: [https://discord.gg/jKyaf3PMbq](https://discord.gg/wENBYVtngz)


We hope you enjoy,
- Lux

The Venture Inc. Team
